title: Chapter 657
text:
The Six Nations had declared war without any warning, as though they wanted to eliminate the seventh nation that Bennett had built. Bennett had spent an entire day trying to verify this, using his private line to contact the leaders of the Six Nations dozens of times, but all of them had been rejected. He had no idea why the Six Nations had suddenly gone crazy, and he could not handle such a huge matter alone. In the end, he had informed Han Xiao.

If the third round of the mission had not appeared, Han Xiao felt that he would have most likely thought that the Six Nations had grown stronger and obtained the technology brought by the galactic financial group, causing their confidence to swell, and they wanted to take back their power. However, this possibility was very slim. The Six Nations were not idiots. The more they came into contact with the galaxy, the more they would realize how insignificant they were. The gap between them could be seen, and it was very difficult for the Six Nations to be arrogant.

The galactic financial group had only invested in Blue Star because of his and Floating Dragon's name. He was the one who had single-handedly led the rapid development of Blue Star. In Han Xiao's understanding, the Six Nations should have known very well that they were hugging his thigh, and declaring war on him was equivalent to digging their own graves.

Now, the Six Nations had collectively lost their minds. This was completely illogical.

"There must be a reason for this abnormality. I can basically confirm that there is another force behind this, most likely a new batch of hunters." Han Xiao frowned slightly. "This group of people is even more difficult to deal with. They actually attacked Blue Star to lure me back?"

If he had not received the warning, he would definitely have been shocked once he learned that the Six Nations had betrayed him. He would also have felt that something was amiss, but he would not have been as vigilant as he was now. He would definitely have gone back to investigate the reason.

The Six Nations were just bait, and the real enemy was hiding in the dark. The enemy had the strength to directly destroy Blue Star, but this was meaningless to the enemy. The moment they showed themselves, Han Xiao would be vigilant, and the enemy's real target would be him.

If they destroyed Blue Star, it would be equivalent to destroying the few 'weaknesses' that Black Star had left. The enemy had chosen to use this as a trap and secretly set up an ambush in Blue Star, waiting for Han Xiao, the 'prey', to fall into the trap.

"Thankfully, the mission reminded me …"

Han Xiao secretly let out a sigh of relief. He had to admit that the enemies this time were more cunning than the previous batch. If he hadn't been vigilant, this trap would have very likely fallen into his trap. At that time, he would be in a very passive position.

"Therefore, this is my current advantage. The enemy thinks that I am defenseless, but in reality, I already know of their existence. Originally, the enemy is in the dark while I am in the light, but now, the enemy is in the light while I am in the dark."

Han Xiao pondered. He did not know how the Hunters had instigated the Six Nations to rebel. In fact, it was an overt plot. Blue Star was of great strategic importance. It was a huge leek breeding base. He could not sit back and watch the enemy disrupt the situation that he had worked so hard to build. Therefore, it was impossible for him not to return. He had to deal with the Six Nations.

The enemy had taken advantage of this when they attacked Blue Star.

"Hiding from the enemy will only increase the losses. Only by facing them head-on will I be able to deal with them. Thankfully, I have the advantage and have time to think of a way to break the enemy's trap. The enemy's strength is a mystery, but there should be no less than six Calamity Grade Supers. It will be difficult for me to deal with them alone. I have to find some helpers."

Han Xiao stroked his chin and felt a little troubled. The Dragon Emperor had said that she would not help, and Section Zero was at war. Their allies were too far away. After thinking about it, it seemed like the only ally that could help was Godora.

"The Amethyst Civilization might be able to help …" Han Xiao hesitated. Purple Crystal naturally had quite a few Calamity Grade Supers. As an official Super, they did not participate in the secret war.

However, Han Xiao was not sure if Purple Crystal would help him. They might not be interested in this and only care about the war.

"Let's give it a try first. It's free anyway."

Han Xiao calmed himself down and took out his communicator.

He would definitely find help. Unless there was no one to support him, he would not return alone. This was the last resort.

Being able to build relationships was also a form of strength!

…

At the frontlines of the secret war, the Bloodshed Land's troops had arrived at the West Wind, Chaida, and Kaya Star Systems and started to expand once again. The troops of Section Zero were having a hard time and could only engage in guerilla warfare. At the back, battleship factories were working 24/7 to maintain the main battleships and send them to the frontlines to strengthen the fleet.

The situation of the war was very passive, and countless problems were created every day. Logistics, reinforcements, counterattack routes, battle strategies, and many other matters made Ralph extremely troubled. This was especially so for the high-level combatants.

After all sorts of brainstorming and promises of benefits, the high-level combatants of Section Zero no longer avoided battle. However, they were still unwilling to use their full strength, reserving seventy percent of their strength for self-protection and thirty percent for the enemy. In terms of high-level combatants, Section Zero was still in a state of complete defeat. They were being slaughtered by the bunch of war maniacs from Bloodshed Land, and Ralph missed the reliable Black Star every day.

Although Black Star alone was unable to change the overall situation, only Black Star would give it his all.

Ralph was dealing with matters when his communicator suddenly received a communication request from Black Star. His tired mind suddenly perked up.

"Black Star! You've finally contacted me. Is your leave over? Quickly return to the battlefield. We need you! "

As soon as he picked up the call, Ralph spoke impatiently.

Han Xiao coughed and said, "I'm sorry, but I can't return for the time being. There's an internal conflict in my hometown, Blue Star. Someone wants to overthrow my representative, so I have to return to deal with it."

Ralph was instantly disappointed.

"You called just to inform me?"

"No, no, I'm here to seek help from the Amethyst Civilization."

Ralph was confused. "Is there a need for that? It's just an internal conflict of a surface civilization. Can't you handle it yourself?"

"There's something fishy about this matter …"

Han Xiao did not hide anything and directly revealed the existence of a new batch of hunters. He concealed the source of the information and changed some details.

Currently, only Han Xiao, Aesop, and a few others knew that the real owners of the hunters were The Ancient Ones. When they eliminated Albert and the others previously, Han Xiao did not stop Albert from blaming Klent. Many organizations in the Shattered Star Ring thought that Klent was the mastermind behind this, and Purple Crystal was no exception.

Han Xiao was hinting that Klent had sent out hunters to deal with him.

After Ralph heard this, he connected the dots and almost instantly figured out Klent's' motive '.

Black Star defeated eight Vanguard Officials and displayed the potential of a Beyond Grade A Super. Klent is preparing for a rainy day. Even if there's only a one in a billion chance, they can't let a new Beyond Grade A appear in the Colton Star Cluster and not give Purple Crystal a chance to invest. Therefore, they ordered a group of strong individuals to secretly sneak into the Garton Star System to eliminate Black Star, the Beyond Grade A seed, so as to reduce the number of variables in the secret war!

Ralph was shocked. He felt that he had seen through the truth. The Klent Kingdom's motive was too logical. He could not find any fault with his guess. If it were Purple Crystal, they would also choose to assassinate the potential star of the enemy and not give him a chance to grow.

Ralph's expression became serious, and he said with a deep voice, "I understand now. There's a deeper reason behind this. Black Star, we have high hopes for you. We won't let Klent threaten you so easily. I'll report your request immediately. The higher-ups will probably send some official high-level combatants to help you."

Han Xiao was overjoyed. This matter was much smoother than he had expected. Ralph was not so easy to fool.

However, what he did not know was that the upper echelons of the Amethyst Civilization had already held a private meeting and decided to invest heavily in him, a Beyond Grade A seed. Han Xiao still thought that his position was still an ordinary member of Section Zero. In fact, as long as his request was not too much, the Amethyst Civilization would be willing to help him. In fact, the more they helped, the better. This was their attitude of roping him in.

"By the way, to be safe, I'm going to ask Godora's people to help me," Han Xiao added.

"Godora is the ruler of the Garton Star System, right? I remember that they're your ally. Alright, they're also a civilization under our jurisdiction. Do you need me to inform them?"

"… That's great."

Han Xiaoxin was surprised. Why are the people of Purple Crystal so easy to talk to?

After hanging up, Han Xiao contacted Godora again.

Godora was already his old ally, and Serbia the Fifth agreed without hesitation.

If Black Star had only asked for their help, Godora's people might have hesitated for a while. However, since Purple Crystal had already confirmed their involvement in this matter, Godora's people had nothing to be afraid of. In fact, they could not wait to agree.

In the eyes of Godora's people, Black Star was giving them a chance to build a relationship with a Star Cluster Civilization, connecting the two parties and deepening their relationship.

The specific strategy would have to be discussed at length. Han Xiao chose an uninhabited asteroid near Blue Star as the rendezvous point. He then activated his spaceship and rushed toward the rendezvous point.
